title: お弁当のおかず
lead: 卵焼き・唐揚げ・ウインナー・ミニトマトなど、お弁当の定番のおかず12点です。メニュー表やレシピ、給食だよりに使えます。
subject_en: Flat illustration of bento side dishes, each ONE dish or item centred, appetising colours. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a small serving of kinpira burdock
white rice with a pickled plum
an open bento box filled with rice and side dishes
